records.predicted_sql: SELECT t1.psc_code, t1.award_id, t1.transaction_id, t1.action_date FROM award_transactions t1 JOIN (SELECT psc_code, MAX(action_date) AS max_date FROM award_transactions GROUP BY psc_code) t2 ON t1.psc_code = t2.psc_code AND t1.action_date = t2.max_date

records.question: Show running totals of obligations by fiscal year ordered by action date.
records.gold_sql: SELECT fiscal_year, action_date, federal_action_obligation, SUM(federal_action_obligation) OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY action_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM award_transactions
